verdict.rationale: Runpod publishes a REST API v1 reference and serves a machine-readable OpenAPI spec without a key, and its GraphQL docs include cURL and GraphQL examples. Nothing in the evidence shows the reference is interactive, such as an in-browser try-it console that runs requests. missing for 10: evidence of an interactive try-it/playground in the API reference, examples that can be run in the docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of the reference experience.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: The Runpod REST API v1 provides programmatic access to all Runpod compute resources.
Create, start, stop, and query Pods using the GraphQL API with cURL and GraphQL examples.
https://rest.runpod.io/v1/openapi.json serves the REST API's OpenAPI spec keylessly
